Files of the municipal offices and public meeting facilities

Source: R/public-facility-get.R
public_facility_files.Rd

public_facility_files() lists the file of each year of public_facility_get(): the national release of 市町村役場等及び公的集会施設 (P05) in ksjdata::ksj_available, the prefix of its layers (one per prefecture), the EPSG code of its coordinate reference system, the number of facilities, and its URL. It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

public_facility_files()

Value

A tibble with columns year, file_name, layer_prefix, epsg, n_facilities, and url.

Examples

public_facility_files()
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>    year file_name      layer_prefix  epsg n_facilities url                      
#>   <int> <chr>          <chr>        <int>        <int> <chr>                    
#> 1  2022 P05-22_GML.zip P05-22        6668        79532 https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp…
